# ZUARI Framework — Complete AI Engineering Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Complete zero-hallucination API specification and canonical code recipes for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT).

---

## 1. `@zuari/signals` & `@zuari/dom` (Core Reactive DOM Engine)

```typescript
import { signal, computed, effect, batch } from '@zuari/signals';
import { html, render } from '@zuari/dom';

const count = signal(0);
const doubled = computed(() => count.value * 2);

const view = html`
  <div class="card">
    <h2>Count: ${count} (Doubled: ${doubled})</h2>
    <button @click=${() => batch(() => { count.value += 1; })}>
      Increment
    </button>
  </div>
`;

const { fragment, destroy } = render(view);
document.getElementById('app')!.appendChild(fragment);
```

---

## 2. `@zuari/hardware` (Tactical Optics, FPV Drones, Gaming, KaiOS D-Pad, Smart Appliances, Waveguide/E-Ink Displays)

### 2A. Tactical Smart-Optic Ballistics & 9-Axis IMU (`@zuari/hardware/tactical`)
```typescript
import { createBallisticReticle, createIMUStream } from '@zuari/hardware/tactical';

const reticle = createBallisticReticle({
  rangeMeters: 450,
  windMps: 6.2,
  muzzleVelocityMps: 820,
  cantDeg: 0,
  magCapacity: 30
});
// Reactive outputs: reticle.elevationMrad, reticle.windageMrad, reticle.aimX, reticle.aimY, reticle.ammoRemaining
reticle.triggerShotImpulse(18.5); // Records high-G shot impulse & decrements ammo

const imu = createIMUStream({ roll: 0, pitch: 0, yaw: 180, gForce: 1.0 });
imu.ingestPacket([12.5, -4.2, 182.0, 1.4]); // Updates imu.horizonTransform
```

### 2B. Zero-Copy Binary Drone MAVLink / CRSF Telemetry (`@zuari/hardware/drone`)
```typescript
import { createDroneTelemetry, encodeDroneBinaryFrame } from '@zuari/hardware/drone';

const drone = createDroneTelemetry();
// Decode 16-byte binary telemetry frame directly via DataView (zero JSON overhead)
const packet = encodeDroneBinaryFrame({
  voltage: 23.8,
  altitude: 120.5,
  speed: 88.2,
  rssi: -55,
  lq: 99,
  modeIndex: 0, // 'ACRO' | 'STAB' | 'RTH' | 'LOITER' | 'ARMED' | 'DISARMED'
  cells: 6
});
drone.decodeBinaryFrame(packet);
```

### 2C. Handheld Gaming, Rabbit R1 Scroll Wheel & Playdate Crank (`@zuari/hardware/gaming`)
```typescript
import { createRotaryController, createGamepadSignal } from '@zuari/hardware/gaming';

const wheel = createRotaryController({ min: 0, max: 100, step: 1, initial: 50, wrap: true });
const unbind = wheel.bindToElement(window); // Binds physical wheel, ArrowUp/Down, and Spacebar PTT

const gamepad = createGamepadSignal(0.08); // 8% deadzone filter
gamepad.updateFromAxes(0.02, -0.95, 0.4, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0b0001);
```

### 2D. KaiOS, Dumbphone & Feature Phone D-Pad + T9 Keypad (`@zuari/hardware/dpad`)
```typescript
import { createDpadNav } from '@zuari/hardware/dpad';

const dpad = createDpadNav({
  itemCount: 6,
  columns: 1,
  wrap: true,
  onSelect: (index) => console.log('Selected item:', index)
});
// Handle hardware keypad events: 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'Enter', 'SoftLeft', 'SoftRight', '0'-'9'
dpad.handleKeyEvent('ArrowDown');
dpad.pressT9Digit('2'); // Multi-tap T9 buffer ('a' -> 'b' -> 'c' -> '2')
```

### 2E. Smart Fridge / Appliance MQTT Router & OLED Burn-In Guard (`@zuari/hardware/appliance`)
```typescript
import { createApplianceBridge } from '@zuari/hardware/appliance';

const appliance = createApplianceBridge();
const freezerTemp = appliance.subscribeTopic('fridge/freezer/tempC', -19);
appliance.publishPacket('fridge/freezer/tempC', -21);
appliance.triggerPixelOrbitTick(); // Shifts pixelShiftOffset { x, y } to prevent OLED burn-in
```

### 2F. Optical Waveguide (530nm Green), NVG, Thermal & 1-Bit E-Ink (`@zuari/hardware/display`)
```typescript
import { createDisplayMode } from '@zuari/hardware/display';

// Presets: 'standard' | 'waveguide-green' | 'nvg-phosphor' | 'thermal-flir' | 'laser-pin' | 'eink-1bit'
const display = createDisplayMode('waveguide-green');
const stopDisplay = display.applyToElement(document.body);
```

## 3. `@zuari/wasm` (Zero-Copy Rust / Zig / C Linear Memory Bridge)

```typescript
import { createWasmSignal, createWasmStruct } from '@zuari/wasm';

const memory = new ArrayBuffer(64);
const sim = createWasmStruct({ memory, baseOffset: 0 }, {
  x:        { offset: 0,  type: 'f64', initial: 10.5 },
  y:        { offset: 8,  type: 'f64', initial: 20.0 },
  entities: { offset: 16, type: 'u32', initial: 5000 }
});

// Mutating signal flushes directly to byte offset 0 in Wasm linear memory
sim.x.signal.value = 99.25;
// Syncing from Wasm reads raw bytes back into the reactive signal
sim.entities.syncFromWasm();
```

## 4. `@zuari/spatial` (visionOS & Meta Quest 3 WebXR 120 FPS HUDs)

```typescript
import { createSpatialAnchor, bindAnchorToElement, triggerSpatialHaptic } from '@zuari/spatial';

const anchor = createSpatialAnchor({
  id: 'hud-dock',
  initialPosition: { x: 0, y: 1.4, z: -0.8 }
});

const hudElement = document.getElementById('hud')!;
const unbindHud = bindAnchorToElement(anchor, hudElement);
anchor.updateTransform({ x: 0.1, y: 1.45, z: -0.75 });
```

## 5. `@zuari/webgpu` (Compute-Shader Backed Reactive Signals)

```typescript
import { createGPUBufferSignal, createComputeShader } from '@zuari/webgpu';

const particles = createGPUBufferSignal({
  initialData: new Float32Array([1, 2, 3, 4])
});

const compute = createComputeShader({
  code: `@group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read_write> data: array<f32>;
         @compute @workgroup_size(64) fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3<u32>) {
           data[id.x] = data[id.x] * 2.0;
         }`,
  bindings: [particles],
  cpuFallback: ([buf]) => { if (buf) for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) buf[i] *= 2; }
});

await compute.dispatch(1);
```

## 6. `@zuari/presets` (Minimal & Artistic UI/UX Presets, Lightweight Elevations, Smooth Animations & Templates)

```typescript
import {
  createDesignPresets,
  animatePreset,
  staggerPreset,
  createStoryCard,
  createBentoGrid,
  createStampBadge
} from '@zuari/presets';

// 1. Reactive theme ('paper' | 'blossom' | 'matcha' | 'twilight' | 'midnight'),
//    lightweight elevation ('flat' | 'soft' | 'float' | 'halo'),
//    spacing ('compact' | 'balanced' | 'airy'), and surface ('paper' | 'frosted' | 'canvas' | 'cel')
const design = createDesignPresets({
  theme: 'paper',
  elevation: 'soft',
  spacing: 'balanced',
  surface: 'paper'
});

// Switch theme or elevation reactively at any time:
design.setTheme('twilight');
design.setElevation('float');

// 2. Ready-to-use artistic UI templates with built-in animations ('floatUp' | 'popIn' | 'slideIn' | 'brushIn' | 'softPulse' | 'ripple')
const card1 = createStoryCard({
  tag: 'Chapter 01',
  stamp: 'NEW',
  title: 'Minimal Canvas',
  subtitle: 'Whisper-light elevation and smooth motion.',
  elevation: 'soft',
  surface: 'paper',
  animation: 'floatUp'
});

const card2 = createStoryCard({
  tag: 'Chapter 02',
  title: 'Twilight Studio',
  subtitle: 'Crisp anime-inspired keyframe transitions.',
  elevation: 'float',
  surface: 'frosted',
  animation: 'popIn'
});

const grid = createBentoGrid({
  columns: 2,
  spacing: 'airy',
  staggerAnimation: 'floatUp',
  items: [card1, card2]
});

document.getElementById('app')!.appendChild(grid);
```

## 7. `@zuari/sync`, `@zuari/ai`, `@zuari/router` & `@zuari/wit` (2026–2028 Horizon Primitives)

```typescript
import { syncedSignal } from '@zuari/sync';
import { createPromptStream } from '@zuari/ai';
import { createRouter } from '@zuari/router';
import { bindWITComponentRecord } from '@zuari/wit';

// Local-First CRDT Signal (OPFS + BroadcastChannel + binary CRDT deltas)
const docTitle = syncedSignal('doc-title', 'Untitled Note');
docTitle.value = 'Zuari Architecture';

// Zero-VDOM On-Device AI Token Streaming directly into a DOM node via Text.appendData()
const aiStream = createPromptStream();
aiStream.bindChildPart(document.getElementById('ai-output')!);
await aiStream.stream('Summarize zero-VDOM reactivity');

// < 1 KB Router with Navigation API + Speculation Rules prerendering + View Transitions Level 2
const router = createRouter({
  routes: [
    { path: '/', action: () => 'Home', prerender: 'moderate' },
    { path: '/notes/:id', action: (params) => `Note ${params.id}` }
  ]
});
await router.navigate('/notes/42');
```
